text:
julie-recruiter: FYI ran into a weird one — bulk scorecard CSV import dropped everything after a • bullet in the long interviewer guidance field for ~12 candidates.

emma-peopleops: oh no. where did the CSV come from? google sheet export?

julie-recruiter: export from Sheets -> csv. The guidance field had a bulleted list using the unicode bullet (•) and some long em-dashes. Import preview looked fine, but after import the guidance truncated at the bullet.

sara-qa: can you paste one problematic row (sanitized) and the resulting rendered scorecard value?

julie-recruiter: row: 
```
candidate_id,panel,scorecard_guidance
abc123,backend,"Please focus on:
• system design depth
• latency tradeoffs — ask about caches
• ownership examples"
```
Imported guidance ended up as: "Please focus on:" (everything after first newline dropped).

leo-engineer: interesting. sounds like our CSV parser treats newline+bullet as a row separator when not quoted correctly. But your export was quoted. Could be our legacy CSV library that chokes on UTF-8 bullets and returns early.

ats-bot: note: CSV importer service v1.4.2 was deployed at 1979995000 (dependency upgraded: simple-csv 0.9 -> 1.0).

leo-engineer: that dependency change might be the culprit; new parser tightened RFC behavior and mishandles multibyte chars in quoted fields for some inputs. I'll add a regression test that includes unicode bullets, em-dash, and long lines.

emma-peopleops: short-term: can we surface a validation step that warns if any guidance fields contain newlines or bullets? We can also give a copy-friendly template that uses hyphens instead.

leo-engineer: will do both. Plan: (1) revert to 0.9 in prod hotfix if regression confirmed, (2) add robust CSV validation and a sanitization step that normalizes bullets -> '-' and converts fancy quotes/em-dash to plain ascii for the importer behind a flag, (3) add a help-tip in the UI and scheduler email mentioning to avoid special bullets when using bulk upload.

sara-qa: I'll run the new regression tests and try reproducing with Sheets exports from macOS and Windows to be safe.

emma-peopleops: also let's schedule a 15-min quick training for recruiters this week on bulk uploads and the new template. I'll own the invite and copy.

julie-recruiter: thanks — if you can add a one-line fallback that preserves the full field as-is into a draft scorecard (not published) we can manually patch the few affected ones while fix rolls out.

leo-engineer: can do. I'll add a fallback path: if parser signals uncertain encoding we'll keep the raw payload in a draft bucket and surface a warning in the UI linking to the draft.

emma-peopleops: perfect. ETA?

leo-engineer: I'll open a PR in ~1.5h. Hotfix revert + draft fallback within 4h. Validation + UI tips by EOD.

julie-recruiter: great, appreciate it. We'll hold off manual mass invites until that's in.

emma-peopleops: thanks team — and please add telemetry event importer.csv_unicode_truncation with file_id, uploader_id so we can see if this was isolated.

ats-bot: automated note: created issue IMPORTER-412 linked to service alerts.
